title: Tears of Steel
announcement: Tears of Steel. Science fiction, 2012, 12 minutes. 34 descriptions.

cues.text: Rocket engines ignite, blasting bright white flames and pinkish plumes from their nozzles.
A rocket launches from a sprawling industrial complex.
On screen: 40 YEARS LATER.
Two figures work at a cluttered console, surrounded by glowing digital overlays.
Through a shadowed doorway, two figures work at a cluttered console.
An elderly person reads a newspaper with bold headlines.
A grey-haired person reads a newspaper while a soldier aims a rifle nearby.
Through a circular viewport, a large, steampunk-style airship hovers above a cityscape.
A grey-haired man sits on a wooden platform, hands resting on his knees, in a dimly lit, cluttered room.
The grey-haired man’s boots grip a thick rope coiled on a weathered, dark stone floor.
Through a blurred foreground, a street scene with buildings and green trees is visible.
A young man walks down a cobblestone street, looking at his phone.
The young man stands by a bridge railing, looking ahead.
A man with glasses adjusts his neck while neon screens glow behind him.
A young man in a jacket looks at a woman with her back to the camera.
The young man with dark hair looks off-camera, his expression neutral.
Neon lights pulse over a control booth with three figures.
A young man with dark hair closes his eyes as a mechanical device rests against his mouth.
A middle-aged man with a mechanical eye points forward, while a young woman stands behind him, watching.
The young man grimaces as he grips a control panel.
A person in a heavy coat aims a large weapon from behind a structure.
A hand in a translucent glove pulls a glowing, cylindrical object from a mechanical chamber, its motion blurred by rapid movement.
Four people in white suits crouch in a sunlit, overgrown, industrial ruin.
A young man in a white jacket grips a complex mechanical device, his gaze fixed forward, while a bearded man in glasses observes behind him.
A young man in a patterned jacket lies prone, gripping a rifle, his eyes wide and focused.
The young man in the patterned jacket leaps through the air.
A massive, dark, mechanical structure looms, lit by glowing circular lights.
A man with curly hair and glasses sits before glowing computer screens, his expression tense as he works in a cluttered, neon-lit tech lab.
A man with a prosthetic eye sits at a cluttered desk.
A grey-haired man in a dark coat gestures toward a massive, dark mechanical structure amidst rubble and wires.
On screen: Produced by TON ROOSENDAAL.
A white mech glows with blue energy.
A glowing blue mechanical structure dominates the frame, its intricate design highlighted against a dark background with orange sparks and debris.
A pile of broken mechs.
